parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the prohibited software tag. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the software prohibition policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListProhibitedPolicies](~~ListProhibitedPolicies~~): Lists software prohibition policies.
- [CreateProhibitedPolicy](~~CreateProhibitedPolicy~~): Creates a software prohibition policy.

parameters.name: SoftwareId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the prohibited software.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The collection of prohibited software tag IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed. A maximum of 500 IDs can be specified.
